answer: Because the timing is recorded against the yarrow challenge, the zephyr audit can replay the violet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 25 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 5 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
